name: Battery Push Common Info
note: Payload layout reconstructed from the P3 flight-recorder's 'Battery Info' log entry, which is a near-superset of what the native smart-battery cmd_set pushes. This is a *candidate* mapping by name/content match (cmd_id 0x06='Battery Push Common Info' in the live BATTERY_UART_CMD_TEXT table), not independently confirmed against this exact firmware's wire traffic. The Center Board's own 'Center Battery Common' struct (cmd_set 0x05 id 0x06, 3-cell, already decoded from the live dissector) is a DIFFERENT, simplified proxy of this same data -- do not conflate the two.
